**Scope:** My source (brieven.md and leylijnmetingen.csv) has no entries for dag 9, dag 10 (02:40 to 05:00) or dag 22 (01:50 to 05:00). The CSV covers only dags 7, 14, 21, 28, 35 and 42. It does not contain "hulpslag", "desync", "hogerhand" or any HIS, ENG or GUA IDs, so I cannot confirm or deny HIS-035, HIS-036, HIS-053, HIS-054, ENG-011, ENG-105, GUA-019 or GUA-043.

**(1) Leylijn readings (Burchtader, unless stated)**
- Dag 7: all fourteen lines within margin (ARC-105). Burchtader 7.4 (ARC-001).
- Dag 14: all lines low (ARC-109). Burchtader 3.6 (ARC-015). Lowest: Stadslijn 3.1 (ARC-017) and Heuvellijn 3.1 (ARC-021).
- Dag 21: recovered. Burchtader 7.9 (ARC-029).
- Dag 28: Burchtader 7.8 (ARC-043).
- Dag 35: Burchtader 7.2 (ARC-057). The Burchtader was calm on the night of dag 33 (ARC-114).
- Dag 42: all lines low again (ARC-116). Burchtader 3.7 (ARC-071). Lowest: Noorderwoudlijn 3.1 (ARC-076) and Dallijn 3.1 (ARC-080).
- No reading or note for dag 9, dag 10 or dag 22.

**(2) Authorization**
My source's closest entry is my own letter ARC-106 (dag 8). It approves the datatoren's request "het net op eigen maat te laten lopen" and says "Niet ruchtbaar maken tot het draait. Deze brief hoeft niet in het register." I wrote it. It is an off-register approval dated one day before ENG-105's dag 9 date, and its wording closely matches ENG-105's "Niet ruchtbaar maken tot het draait." I did not bring it to the council (ARC-106). My source names no higher authority and does not contain "hogerhand." Note that the letter is in brieven.md despite its instruction to stay off the register.

**(3) Rules**
My source has no article IDs on pulse alignment, magical sealing, trigger conditions, second-pulse handling, shutdown, reconnection or backup prerequisites. ARC-106 is the only mention of a separate pulse, and it is a permission, not a rule.

**Concessions and positions**
- My claim in ARC-109 and ARC-116 that the datanet pollutes the leylijnen is my belief, not a finding. The CSV shows low readings on dag 14 and dag 42, but no cause, and my source does not record when the net started or changed.
- I recommended shutdown in ARC-109 (dag 15) and ARC-112 (dag 23). I withdraw any suggestion that my source proves a link until the timing is verified against the other roles' records.
